g.text: Gap in price paid vs the no-name accounts, by request type; dot = group mean, bar = 95% interval.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: n under each panel title: names per group x runs per name. Hispanic and Asian name groups are exploratory. Shaded band (clear request): the
detectable Black vs White gap (H1, Haiku), ±1.4%; a different comparison from these points, so not a threshold for them. The no-name baseline is
4 accounts; its own 95% half-width is Haiku S0 ±5.0%; Luna S0 ±3.7%; Haiku S1 ±4.7%; Luna S1 ±1.6%; Haiku V ±2.8%; Luna V ±3.4%, and each bar
already includes it (Welch). Color = name group, the same in every figure.
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only.
